title: The Income Tax Act, 2000
verified_how: fetched the Office of the King's Printer Publications Centre record for product 583 through the site's own JSON API (/api/v1/products/583): name 'The Income Tax Act, 2000', Chapter I-2.01 of the Statutes of Saskatchewan, 2000, effective 1 January 2001, as amended, 'Last update posted: 16 Sep 2026'
notes: Saskatchewan's own personal (and corporate) income tax. Collection and source withholding are performed federally by the Canada Revenue Agency under a collection agreement, so the withholding machinery is in the federal Income Tax Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.). This was the most recently updated consolidation in the Saskatchewan set.
